textbookBox.ref: CBSE Class 4 english · Together We Can (poem) · Textbook Concepts
textbookBox.concept: The poem says that when we stand together we are strong, and when we help each other we never fall. It says that teams cheer aloud, win or lose, and always share and trust each other.

1.tip: Look closely at the diagram on the board as we explain each property.

beats.speakEn: The poem says that when we stand together we are strong, and when we help each other we never fall. It says that teams cheer aloud, win or lose, and always share and trust each other.

beats.en: Joining hands with your team makes everyone feel safe and strong, because you know others are with you. Helping each other is important because everyone is good at something different and a job is done faster together.

textbookBox.ref: CBSE Class 4 english · Together We Can (poem) · Deeper Textbook Ideas
textbookBox.concept: Bokali and Darsana love their country. They say that we have different traditions, food, festivals and languages, but we still stand in unity.

beats.en: Bokali and Darsana love their country. They say that we have different traditions, food, festivals and languages, but we still stand in unity.
beats.speakEn: Bokali and Darsana love their country. They say that we have different traditions, food, festivals and languages, but we still stand in unity.

beats.en: We use special names for groups of animals, people and things. A bundle of sticks, a herd of sheep, a pack of wolves, a bouquet of flowers, a grove of trees, a swarm of bees, a choir of boys and a bunch of keys.
beats.speakEn: We use special names for groups of animals, people and things. A bundle of sticks, a herd of sheep, a pack of wolves, a bouquet of flowers, a grove of trees, a swarm of bees, a choir of boys and a bunch of keys.

textbookBox.ref: CBSE Class 4 english · Together We Can (poem) · Complete Summary
textbookBox.concept: On the map the post office, hospital, bank, school, bookstore and children's park are in different places. Behind means at the back of something. In front of means before it, facing it.

beats.en: Let us review the key takeaway from Together We Can (poem): On the map the post office, hospital, bank, school, bookstore and children's park are in different places. Behind means at the back of something. In front of means before it, facing it. Near means close to it.
